beats.text:
He's wiping his hands on a rag that stopped being clean a long time ago.

He keeps doing it after they're dry.

text.Guns: That's not a habit. That's something he can't put down.
text.Bible: He's cleaning something that was never on his hands.
text.Crystals: His hands have been dry for a while now. He hasn't noticed. Or he has, and it doesn't matter.

beats.speaker: SAMUN
beats.text: Hey. {slow}Hey.{/slow}{pause:350} You need something, or you just walking around tonight?

options.label: Look at his hands until he stops.
